title: Entity Cleaner
description: Automatically removes unwanted entities like items, arrows, XP orbs, and projectiles to improve performance.
body:
![Entity Cleaner - About x18px](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/549e4dd28a1be267ef870b493d159b5d98bcbf22_0.webp)

This standalone datapack/mod is a powerful upgrade verison to the original [Lag Sweeper](https://modrinth.com/datapack/lagsweeper-datapack), designed to work seamlessly across multiple Minecraft versions. It efficiently clears a wide range of entities, including dropped items, eggs, snow, arrows, shulker bullets, wither skulls, and more, reducing lag and keeping your world running smoothly.

![Blank Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2e98111b05a2ecc7a51024d1a66189b937f7c952_0.webp)

![Entity Cleaner - dependencies](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b1266253eb0b631a12d6cb46a66a4c9978c97e9c_0.webp)

* **Singleplayer**: If you're using the datapack or mod in a singleplayer world, install the [Singleplayer Library](https://modrinth.com/datapack/singleplayer-lib). It automatically grants you the ec_operator tag, so you don't need to enable cheats. Alternatively, if you have access to commands, you can manually grant yourself operator access with: ```/tag @s add ec_operator```

* **Multiplayer:** **"Do not install the Singleplayer Library".** On multiplayer servers, core Entity Cleaner settings should remain restricted to server administrators. To grant a player permission to modify Entity Cleaner settings, use: ```/tag <player_name> add ec_operator```

![Blank Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2e98111b05a2ecc7a51024d1a66189b937f7c952_0.webp)

![Entity Cleaner - Features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/64dcc9aff4ec5cc25fca6ecf3d668e5e0359ab04_0.webp)

- Multi-version compatibility – Works reliably on different Minecraft versions without errors.
- Comprehensive entity cleanup – Removes common lag-causing entities automatically (Every 5min).
- Lightweight and easy to use – Install and run without affecting gameplay performance.
- Optimized for servers and singleplayer – Keeps both worlds and servers smooth, even with high entity counts.
- Easy-to-customize item cleaner config: choose which items to delete, set the cleanup time, and more.

![Blank Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2e98111b05a2ecc7a51024d1a66189b937f7c952_0.webp)

![Entity Cleaner - Command description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/90ca1a4bad5eeaf89f5b04e9d76d66699683c81e_0.webp)

- `/trigger ec_menu`: Opens the Entity Cleaner configuration menu.
- `/tag player_name add ec_operator`: Gives permission to modify the Entity Cleaner configuration.

* ![A demo image of config menu of datapack/plugin (Entity Cleaner)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bd8fe976572e674f9c7d1bc3da1bb473fd46adce.png)

![Entity Cleaner - Question and Answer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3a67bf2c759b72661fd0e3a7bf654ce2021d11fc_0.webp)

<details>
<summary>What does Entity Cleaner do?</summary>
Entity Cleaner helps improve server performance by automatically removing unwanted entities such as dropped items, XP orbs, projectiles, and other selected entities after a configurable amount of time.
</details>

<details>
<summary>How to get Operate on entity cleaner?</summary>
 Run ingame command run command /tag player_name ec_operator 
</details>

<details>
<summary>Can I customize what entities get removed?</summary>
Yes! Entity Cleaner comes with a fully customizable configuration where you can choose which entities should be removed or kept. You can enable or disable cleaning for items, mobs, projectiles, minecarts, boats, and more (/trigger ec_menu).
</details>

<details>
<summary>Can I change the cleanup time?</summary>
Yes. You can configure the cleanup interval and choose how often Entity Cleaner checks and removes unwanted entities (/trigger ec_menu).
</details>

<details>
<summary>Will it remove important entities?</summary>
No. Entity Cleaner allows you to control exactly what gets removed. By default, only selected entities are cleaned, and you can disable any category you want from the config.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Can I use this on a multiplayer server?</summary>
Yes. Entity Cleaner is designed for servers and can help reduce unnecessary entity buildup, improving performance for players.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Does Entity Cleaner delete items instantly?</summary>
No. Items are removed based on your configured cleanup timer, giving players enough time to collect dropped items before they are cleared.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Can I see when cleanup happens?</summary>
Yes. Notification settings can be configured to show cleanup messages when entities are removed.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Does Entity Cleaner affect mob farms?</summary>
No. Entity Cleaner only removes selected item-related entities and does not remove mobs, so your mob farms will work normally. It is safe to use on servers without affecting mob spawning or farms.
</details>
